title: Intrinsic Visual Finding
description: A single-render property of the target, checked without any comparison. These survive content differences, which is what makes them the backbone of independent-content mode. `correlation` records whether the reference exhibits the same condition — if it does, the finding is demoted rather than reported as a target defect.

rule.description: The three checks implemented so far. The plan's remaining ten are not implemented in the vertical slice and must not be listed here until they are.

correlation.description: reference-correlated findings are demoted to informational: a target reproducing the reference's condition is reproducing the reference.
